visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a black beret, black long-sleeved crop top, and a short black ruffled skirt is dancing energetically in an indoor room with plain white walls. The person has long brown hair and is performing rhythmic arm and leg movements. Several items of clothing and bags are scattered on the floor in the background. (2) The person stops dancing to answer a smartphone that appears in their left hand. Their facial expression shifts from playful to shocked and wide-eyed while speaking. They gesture with their free hand in an animated manner. (3) The person crouches down to look through the items on the floor. They pick up a blue clutch bag, examine it with a disapproving pout, and then throw it aside. They then pick up a green fabric tote and a camouflage print bag, inspecting both with a critical facial expression before discarding them. (4) The person discovers a large white leather-style handbag. Their expression transforms into pure joy and excitement. They stand up, loop the strap over their shoulder, and begin posing confidently, touching their hair and smiling broadly at the camera. (5) The person resumes dancing with high energy while wearing the white handbag. They point at the bag and their outfit, performing exaggerated hip thrusts and hand waves. The scene concludes with the person moving closer to the camera with a wide, triumphant grin.
